select F.FINPROD_ID as id, F.FINPROD_ABBR as text, F.FINPROD_TYPE || F.VDATE || F.MDATE as object from FIN_PRODUCT F /**标的类金融产品**/ where (F.Finprod_Type2 in (#{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F01},#{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F07},#{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F18}) OR (F.Finprod_Type2 = #{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F17} AND F.Profit_Type in (#{PROFITTYPE_VALUE_02})))
AND (F.FINPROD_ID like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR F.FINPROD_ABBR like '%' || #{search} || '%')

select B.BOOKSET_ID as id, B.BOOKSET_NAME as text from BOK_BOOKSET B /**账套表**/ where B.BOOKSET_TYPE = '02'
AND (B.BOOKSET_ID like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR B.BOOKSET_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%')
